lines.idle: Master, let's do our best today too!
The heartleaf is looking extra lively today~
Hehe, watch me play a tune with my ladle!
lines.headpat: Hehe, whenever Master pets me like this, I almost forget about messing up the recipe earlier!
Ugh... feels so good... just a little longer...
Master's hands have a warm, magical touch.
lines.poke: Ugh... I'm calculating profits right now, Master, don't distract me!
Hmph! ...I-I wasn't smiling secretly at all.
lines.panic: Wait! Waaah! Too fast, too fast! I'll get dumber!
lines.shy: I've been petted plenty today... Master should get back to work too!
If you keep petting me, I won't get anything done today...
lines.daily: Good morning, Master! I'm counting on your guidance today!
Ah, Master is here! I'll do my best today too!
lines.exhausted: Hah... so sleepy... I'll just go lie down on the cushion for a bit...
lines.woke: All rested up! Back to work for me!
mutter.global: Such lovely weather for brewing potions~
Mm~ Such a sweet fragrance drifting through the shop.
Is Master watching? I'm working super hard!
Bookkeeping, bookkeeping... Ah, we're in the black today too!
I'll brew some black tea once we close.
Someday I'm gonna be a great, powerful witch!
This shop is my absolute favorite place.
mutter.greenhouse: Grow nice and plump today, heartleaf~
Watering, watering~ Gotta be careful not to drown them.
I heard talking to plants makes them grow faster!
Heave-ho, this pot looks ready for harvest!
There's a little bug on the leaf... Shoo, shoo~
The moonshrooms are glowing... So pretty.
mutter.cauldron: Stir three times, then one time in reverse...
Heat... temperature control is super important!
I singed my bangs here last time... Not happening today!
Mister Ladle, I'm counting on you today too.
The color turned a pretty pink, success!
mutter.counter: Welcome~ What kind of potion do you need today?
Making change, making change... Yup, math checks out!
A friendly smile is part of the service!
This bottle is the prettiest one today~
So many customers, gotta stay sharp!
mutter.patrol: Where should I go help out next~
Just doing a quick patrol of the shop!
mutter.outfit.default: Master gave me this hat, you know.
An apprentice witch is a witch too!
mutter.outfit.maid: Welcome back, Master... Ah, I mean welcome!
Maid skirts flutter around so easily...
Gotta pour tea with the most graceful posture...
mutter.outfit.pajama: Working in my pajamas... I'm getting kind of sleepy...
Aren't the little star patterns cute? Hehe.
mutter.outfit.robe: Wearing this robe makes me feel so cool!
Master Alchemist Lumia, reporting for duty!
My sleeves are so long... Almost fell right into the cauldron.
mutter.outfit.gardener: I wove this flower crown from the greenhouse flowers!
My apron pockets are stuffed with seeds~
Grow big and strong today, little plants!
mutter.relax: Time to kick back and relax today~
The cushion soaked up the sun, it's so fluffy...
The stars outside are so pretty.
Master won't mind if I slack off just a little bit, right?
mutter.furniture.snack: Stealing a bite of a snack... Just one bite!
Master's homemade treats are the best~
mutter.furniture.slime_doll: The slime doll is so squishy~ Squish squish!
Hehe, wanna take a nap together today?
mutter.furniture.gramophone: Let's put on a cheerful little tune♪
mutter.furniture.tea_set: Brewing some magical black tea for a break~
Smells so good, I'm energized again after drinking!
mutter.furniture.bouquet: The flowers are still blooming nicely, gotta remember to change the water.
mutter.furniture.hairpin: Is my hairpin on straight? Hehe.
All sparkly and shiny, I love it!
mutter.furniture.star_lamp: The star lamp is lit, what should I wish for?
I hope I can run the shop with Master tomorrow too~
mutter.furniture.music_box: Wind up the music box... The little sprite is dancing again!
mutter.furniture.dream_catcher: The dream catcher caught all the bad dreams!
I'm gonna have sweet dreams tonight...
mutter.furniture.crystal_ball: In the crystal ball... I see so many customers!
mutter.starved: We're running low on ingredients... Gotta grow more.
The cauldron is waiting for materials... Greenhouse, do your best!
mutter.crowded: There's a huge line at the counter...
Customers are waiting, gotta move fast!
mutter.fever: Amazing, everything is moving so fast!
mutter.marketHot: So many customers today, I'm glad I stocked up early!
Potions are flying off the shelves~ Gotta keep up with demand!
mutter.marketCold: Fewer customers today... Let's stash away some potions for now.
Business is a bit quiet, I'll send the extra stuff to the buyback crate.
wish.lines.new: Master, Master, I have a little wish...
Ehehe, could I ask Master for a favor?
Suddenly I really want to see that thing~
wish.lines.done: Wow! It really came true! Thank you, Master!
Master is the best! I'm so happy~
Hehe, wishes coming true feels so nice!
wish.lines.fail: It's okay~ We'll try our best together next time!
So close... But good job, Master!
event.lines.start: There's a customer... No wait, a visitor!
story.celebration.title: First Celebration Party
story.celebration.lines: Lumia: Master, Master! Can you stay for a moment after we close today?
Lumia: Ta-da~! I made a cake with the leftover ingredients! Even though... it's a little bit lopsided.
Lumia: We couldn't have kept the potion shop open this long without all your help, Master.
Lumia: Cheers! To our potion shop, and... to Master!
(From today on, Lumia's confident smile makes customers willing to pay triple the price.)
story.vow.title: Oath Under the Stars
story.vow.lines: Lumia: Master, there are so many stars out tonight.
Lumia: When I found you in the attic that day, I thought you were just a very, very old book.
Lumia: But you've taught me so much... not just recipes, but how to believe in myself.
Lumia: So I want to make a promise with you—let's keep running this shop together, always and forever.
(The Grimoire's pages emit a warm glow. "Fever Time" unlocked!)
